features.name: Application title display
features.notes: UIA tree shows SampleTitle Text 'ApplicationData' visible at top. Confirmed via winapp ui inspect.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Title text 'ApplicationData' is visible at the top of the page

features.name: Scenario list with Clear and SetVersion
features.notes: UIA tree shows NavigationView 'Scenarios' with MenuItemsHost containing 'itm-1clear' ListItem '1) Clear' and 'itm-2setversion' ListItem '2) SetVersion'.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A navigation list/panel shows at least two items

features.name: Selecting a scenario navigates to its page
features.notes: Clicking 'itm-2setversion' via SelectionItemPattern navigated to SetVersion page (confirmed by UIA tree showing SetVersion0/SetVersion1 buttons). Clicking 'itm-1clear' navigated back to Clear page.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Clicking 'Clear' shows the Clear scenario content
Clicking 'SetVersion' shows the SetVersion scenario content

features.name: Clear scenario description text
features.notes: UIA tree shows Text element 'The ClearAsync method clears data from ApplicationData.' in Clear scenario content area.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Text mentioning 'ClearAsync' is visible on the Clear scenario page

features.name: Clear button present and functional
features.notes: Button 'Clear ApplicationData' found in UIA tree. Invoking it via InvokePattern returned OutputTextBlock value 'ApplicationData has been cleared.  Visit the other scenarios to see that their data has been cleared.'

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A button labeled 'Clear' (or similar) is visible
Clicking the button shows 'ApplicationData has been cleared' confirmation text

features.name: SetVersion scenario description text
features.notes: UIA tree shows Text 'Versioning enables you to change the application data format used in a future release...' on SetVersion page.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Text about versioning and application data format is visible

features.name: Set version 0 and Set version 1 buttons
features.notes: UIA tree shows SetVersion0 Button 'Set application data version to 0' and SetVersion1 Button 'Set application data version to 1'.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A button for setting version to 0 is visible
A button for setting version to 1 is visible

features.name: Version display updates after clicking version buttons
features.notes: Invoked SetVersion1 → OutputTextBlock showed 'Version: 1'. Invoked SetVersion0 → showed 'Version: 0'. On initial navigation showed 'Version: 0'.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: On initial navigation, the current version is displayed
